operator_intent: Move the next objectives faster with Codex direction; do not wait for TOD to discover the path alone.
goal: Push TOD toward self-reliant Codex-grade execution by improving task selection, successor dispatch, blocker repair, evidence gates, scope discipline, continuity, validation, stale recovery, escalation quality, and learning feedback.
principles: No terminal state without a successor state.
Resolve blockers through MIM/TOD first, then Codex, then external dependency, then Dave only when unavoidable.
Every issue becomes a learning record.
Every objective has acceptance criteria, current driving task, owner, and evidence expectation.

objectives.title: TOD Next Action Selection Competency V1
objectives.acceptance: After any completed, blocked, failed, rejected, or superseded TOD result, TOD produces a candidate next action with lane, reason, confidence, and validation evidence.

objectives.title: TOD Result to Successor Dispatch Loop V1
objectives.acceptance: Every fresh TOD result produces either a completed closeout, a successor task, a blocker repair task, an escalation packet, or an archive decision.

objectives.title: TOD Autonomous Blocker Repair Ladder V1
objectives.acceptance: For each blocked project, TOD proposes the next repair level, executes what it can, and escalates only with a clear evidence packet.

objectives.title: TOD Evidence First Completion Gate V1
objectives.acceptance: TOD marks work complete only when acceptance criteria has matching proof.

objectives.title: TOD Scope Split Enforcement V1
objectives.acceptance: TOD detects scope expansion, creates a follow-on candidate, and preserves original acceptance.

objectives.title: TOD Continuity Brief Execution Gate V1
objectives.acceptance: TOD refuses implementation until a continuity brief exists for previously touched projects.

objectives.title: TOD Self Validation Regression Probe V1
objectives.acceptance: Every TOD next action includes a validation probe selected from task type, risk, and acceptance criteria.

objectives.title: TOD Stale Project Recovery Sweep V1
objectives.acceptance: No stale/waiting project remains without promote, block, archive, bounded task, Dave decision, external dependency, or Codex escalation.

objectives.title: TOD Codex Escalation Packet Quality V1
objectives.acceptance: Every Codex escalation includes objective, context, acceptance, files, attempts, blockers, evidence, requested action, and validation plan.

objectives.title: TOD Execution Learning Feedback Loop V1
objectives.acceptance: Each completed, failed, blocked, rejected, rescued, or escalated task creates a learning record and updated policy.

first_codex_direction: Seed all ten objectives into Studio Projects.
Verify each objective receives TOD next-action candidate coverage.
Use auto-interventions to force missing acceptance/blocker/scope/stale issues into explicit driving tasks.
Backfill first learning examples from the Studio Projects Table Organization rescue and current auto-interventions.
